quest_pool.title: Berry Picking
quest_pool.objective: Collect 5 wild berries from the Enchanted Forest
quest_pool.description: The tavern's running low on berries for pies! Could you gather some from near Flicker's den?

quest_pool.title: Rabbit Stew Supplies
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 3 rabbits for fresh stew meat
quest_pool.description: We need fresh rabbit meat for tonight's stew! Hunt some rabbits in the meadow.

quest_pool.title: Mushroom Foraging
quest_pool.objective: Collect 8 mushrooms from the Enchanted Forest
quest_pool.description: I need mushrooms for a special recipe! They grow all over the forest floor.

quest_pool.title: Herbal Remedies
quest_pool.objective: Collect 10 healing herbs from the meadow
quest_pool.description: Some travelers have been feeling under the weather. Collect healing herbs for remedies.

quest_pool.title: Wolf Problem
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 2 wolves that have been spotted near the forest
quest_pool.description: Wolves have been scaring travelers on the forest path. Deal with them!

quest_pool.title: Fresh Eggs Needed
quest_pool.objective: Collect 6 fresh eggs from the henhouse
quest_pool.description: The hens have been laying extra eggs! Go collect some for breakfast service.

quest_pool.title: Firewood for the Hearth
quest_pool.objective: Collect 12 pieces of firewood from the forest
quest_pool.description: The tavern's hearth needs restocking! Gather firewood from fallen branches.

quest_pool.title: Venison for the Special
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 1 deer for tomorrow's special meal
quest_pool.description: I want to serve venison as tomorrow's special! Hunt a deer in the meadow.

quest_pool.title: Apple Pie Ingredients
quest_pool.objective: Collect 10 apples from the orchard
quest_pool.description: Apple pie is the most requested dessert! Get fresh apples from the orchard.

quest_pool.title: Wild Boar Hunt
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 1 wild boar for roasted meat
quest_pool.description: A wild boar has been spotted in the forest! Dangerous, but the meat is incredible.

quest_pool.title: Wolf Pelts for Winter
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 2 wolves and bring back their pelts
quest_pool.description: *grunts* Wolves been too bold lately. Need pelts for repairs. Hunt two. Bring pelts.

quest_pool.title: Ranger's Remedy
quest_pool.objective: Collect 6 healing herbs from the forest
quest_pool.description: *scratches beard* Running low on medicine. Forest has what I need. Bring herbs.

quest_pool.title: Boar Problem
quest_pool.objective: Hunt the aggressive boar tearing up the forest trails
quest_pool.description: *frowns* Big boar. Tearing up roots. Bad for the forest. Deal with it.

quest_pool.title: Firewood Gathering
quest_pool.objective: Gather 8 pieces of dry firewood
quest_pool.description: *nods toward forest* Need firewood. Dry branches only. Wet wood smokes too much.

quest_pool.title: Check the Snares
quest_pool.objective: Hunt 3 rabbits from the snare lines
quest_pool.description: *gestures vaguely* Set snares yesterday. Check them. Bring back what you find.

quest_pool.title: Forage for Mushrooms
quest_pool.objective: Collect 5 edible mushrooms from the forest floor
quest_pool.description: *points at treeline* Good mushrooms near the old oak. Brown caps. Not the red ones. Red ones kill you.

quest_pool.title: Venison for the Larder
quest_pool.objective: Hunt a deer for meat and hide
quest_pool.description: *checks bow* Deer been grazing near the stream. Good meat. Good leather. Bring one down.

quest_pool.title: Contain the Aether Moths
quest_pool.description: Oh dear, the aether moths got loose again! They're everywhere and they EAT magical writing! Please catch them before they destroy my research notes!
quest_pool.objective: Collect 3 Aether Moths before they chew through Elowen's spell notes.

quest_pool.title: Find the Lost Crystal Focus
quest_pool.description: I've misplaced my crystal focus - the glowy purple one, very important! I had it just this morning... or was it last week? Please help me find it!
quest_pool.objective: Elowen misplaced a very important glowing crystal. Find it somewhere in town.

quest_pool.title: Retrieve the Enchantment Quill
quest_pool.description: My enchantment quill is MISSING! It glows pink and writes spells on its own! Someone must have taken it - or... did I leave it somewhere? Either way, I need it back!
quest_pool.objective: Someone took Elowen's pink-glowing enchantment quill. Recover it.

quest_pool.title: Help with a Potion Mishap
quest_pool.description: Oh no no NO! The cauldron is doing the thing again! It's bubbling green and making angry noises! I need herbs - lots of herbs - to stabilize it before something explodes!
quest_pool.objective: Collect 5 herbs so Elowen can fix a bubbling cauldron incident.

wolf_menace.name: The Wolf Menace
wolf_menace.description: A series of quests dealing with a growing wolf threat in the forest

quests.title: Wolves on the Path
quests.objective: Hunt 2 wolves that have been threatening travelers
quests.description: There have been reports of wolves attacking travelers on the forest path. I need someone to thin their numbers.
quests.next_quest_intro: Good work! But I've heard troubling news... a pack leader has been spotted. Return when you're ready for more.

quests.title: Track the Pack
quests.objective: Find wolf tracks and follow them to the den
quests.description: The wolves must have a den nearby. Search the forest for wolf tracks that might lead us to their lair.
quests.next_quest_intro: You found their den! There's one more thing I need you to do...

quests.title: The Alpha
quests.objective: Hunt the alpha wolf that's threatening the village
quests.description: The alpha has grown bold - it's been spotted in the village square itself! This beast must be stopped before someone gets hurt!
quests.chain_complete_message: You've done it! The village is safe once more. You are a true hero!

fey_mystery.name: The Fey Mystery
fey_mystery.description: Investigate strange happenings in the Feywilds

quests.title: Strange Lights
quests.objective: Collect glowing mushrooms that appeared overnight
quests.description: Something WEIRD is happening in the Feywilds! Glowing mushrooms have appeared everywhere overnight! I need samples!
quests.next_quest_intro: Fascinating! These mushrooms have fey magic in them! We need to investigate further!

quests.title: Pixie Dust Trail
quests.description: The mushrooms lead to pixie dust! Follow the trails and collect samples. Be careful - pixies can be mischievous!
quests.next_quest_intro: The pixies are trying to tell us something! One more task...

quests.title: The Fey Circle
quests.objective: Find and activate the ancient fey circle
quests.description: There's an ancient fey circle deep in the Feywilds! Find it and place the mushrooms and dust there!
quests.chain_complete_message: The fey are pleased! They've blessed you with their magic!

tavern_troubles.name: Tavern Troubles
tavern_troubles.description: Help Bran deal with a series of problems at the Prancing Pony

quests.title: Rat Infestation
quests.objective: Clear the cellar of giant rats
quests.description: There are GIANT RATS in my cellar! They're eating through the food stores! Help!
quests.next_quest_intro: The rats are gone, but now there's another problem...

quests.title: Restocking the Pantry
quests.objective: Gather supplies to replace what the rats ate
quests.description: Those rats ruined half my supplies! I need mushrooms, berries, and herbs to restock!
quests.next_quest_intro: Thank you! But there's one more thing...

quests.title: The Special Ingredient
quests.objective: Hunt a boar for the grand reopening feast
quests.description: I want to host a grand reopening feast! Hunt me a boar - the guests will love it!
quests.chain_complete_message: The feast was a SUCCESS! You're welcome at the Prancing Pony anytime!
